title: Looking at flights to Chicago now #spamalot #boopthemusical
transcript: The past few days, we have gotten a couple of long awaited and very exciting pieces of casting news, both Broadway and pre Broadway. So here's a very mini theater news recap. The Spamalot Lancelot mystery has finally been solved. The first Lancelot to join this revival will be Taryn Killam. I've loved him on SNL, and this is his second Broadway show. He was previously King George and Hamilton. I'm really glad he's coming to Broadway. This is honestly my favorite piece of casting news to come out of this revival. And he's doing a very limited run just from Halloween to January 7th. And then on January 9th, Alex Brightman takes over in the role that he previously did at the Kennedy Center. I can't believe I went from being lukewarm on this revival to not wanting to see it twice, but here we are. And then this morning, we got the long awaited Boop announcement. Jasmine Rogers is going to be our Betty Boop in the Boop musical, premiering in Chicago starting in November may. Historical perspective. There was a lot of talk about whether or not Betty Boop was going to be cast as a woman of color, considering that the original cartoon character was based off of an actual white woman who based a lot of her mannerisms and her act on women of color. So historically, this is taking the character of Betty Boop back to her roots, which I love to see. And Jasmine Rogers is Perfect for this role. I most recently saw her as Gretchen in the Mean Girls national tour and she was a 2017 Jimmy Awards finalist.
